start: Members page (menu: Members), signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: Title "Members" with "{n} members" under it; buttons "+ Add member" and "Import from Excel"; tabs "All members" and "Joined in the app"
must_not: A count that differs from the rows in the list

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member" with "Full name", "Code", "Mobile number", "Joining date" and optional boxes
must_not: The form opening with another member's values in it

steps.action: Type a full name and a 10-digit mobile number, leave the rest
user_sees: Hint "Used to find them, and to send them WhatsApp messages."
must_not: Any optional box (email, date of birth, address) being required

steps.action: Tap "Add member"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…", the sheet closes, the new member is in the list and the count is one higher
must_not: Two members made from one tap; a member saved with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap the new member
user_sees: Member page: the name as title, "Member since {day}", buttons "Edit" and "Sell membership", "No memberships yet"

start: Today, quick button "New member" (address /members/new)

steps.action: Tap the quick button "New member" on Today
user_sees: The Members page with the "Add member" sheet already open
must_not: The plain list with no form; the form opening twice

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: The sheet closes; the Members list stays, nothing added
must_not: An empty member saved

start: Today, a home tile such as fees due or plans ending (address /members/f/<tile>)

steps.action: Tap the tile on Today
user_sees: The Members list already narrowed to the same people the tile counted
must_not: A list whose length differs from the number on the tile

steps.action: Tap a member in the list
user_sees: That member's page
must_not: Another member's page

steps.action: Type an unknown address /members/<wrong id>
user_sees: "Member not found" and the button "Back to members"
must_not: A blank page or an endless spinner

start: Members, tab "Joined in the app" (address /members/app); the other kind of member: one who joined from the phone app

steps.action: Tap "Joined in the app"
user_sees: Subtitle "Who has the MettleUp app on their phone"; the list of app members, or "Nobody has joined in the app yet"; "+ Add member" is not shown here
must_not: "Loading…" that never ends; a member of another gym in the list

steps.action: Look at numbers waiting to be confirmed (a member typed a phone number in the app)
user_sees: Each waiting number with the member it would be joined to and a way to confirm or refuse (exact words not read)
must_not: A number joined to a list member with nobody at the desk confirming it

start: A member's page, button "Member card" (the ID card to print or share)

steps.action: Open a member, tap "Member card"
user_sees: A sheet with the member's card: name, photo or initials, the gym name (exact words not read)
must_not: Another member's photo or another gym's logo on the card

steps.action: Print or share the card
user_sees: The browser print or share sheet with the same card
must_not: A blank printed page; the card cut off at the paper edge

start: Members, "+ Add member"

steps.action: Tap "Add member" with every box empty
user_sees: "Type the member’s name." and "Type their mobile number." marked on the boxes; the first wrong box scrolls into view
must_not: A member saved with no name; only one of the two boxes marked

steps.action: Type a mobile number with 7 digits, tap "Add member"
user_sees: "This mobile number looks wrong. Check it and type it again."
must_not: The short number saved

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a member already in the list, tap "Add member"
user_sees: On the mobile box: "{name} already has this mobile number in Members."
must_not: A second member with the same mobile number saved while online

steps.action: Type the mobile number of an archived member
user_sees: A message that names the archived member, so the clash can be solved (exact words not read)
must_not: "Number taken" by someone who cannot be found anywhere

steps.action: Type a name of more than the allowed letters
user_sees: "The name can be at most {max} letters."
must_not: The name saved cut short without a word

start: A member's page, lower buttons

steps.action: Tap "Archive member"
user_sees: Notice "Member archived."; the pill "Archived" on the page; the button now reads "Restore member"
must_not: The member's payments, visits or memberships deleted

steps.action: Go back to Members
user_sees: The archived member is no longer in the list and the count is one lower
must_not: The archived member still counted in "{n} members"

steps.action: Open the archived member again (old link), tap "Restore member"
user_sees: The pill "Archived" goes; the member is back in the list with the same plan and dues as before
must_not: A restored member with a changed end date or lost dues

steps.action: Tap "Edit", change the mobile number, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The new number on the page under "Mobile"
must_not: An edit that silently un-archives or archives the member

start: A member's page with the desk photo button (only when the gym's server keeps photos)

steps.action: Tap the photo button under the avatar and take a photo with the desk computer's camera
user_sees: The camera preview, then the saved photo exactly as the preview showed it
must_not: A flipped photo; the photo saved before the person at the desk confirms it

steps.action: Open the same member on another signed-in device of this gym
user_sees: The same photo
must_not: The photo opening for someone not signed in to this gym, or in another gym

steps.action: Sign in as a member in the phone app and look for the desk notes
user_sees: The member never sees the gym's "Notes" about them
must_not: Desk notes or another member's details shown in the member app

steps.action: Scroll to the sent list
user_sees: The message on top with how many members have seen it and the button "Take back"

must_not: A count that includes people with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp one by one ({n})"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp one by one": one member at a time with the words typed; notes like "{n} without a full mobile number left out" and "{n} sharing a number with someone above, sent once"

steps.action: Send the first, come back, go on; tap "Skip" for one; tap "Done"
user_sees: Back on the page: "{x} of {n} done on WhatsApp for this message."

must_not: "Happy birthday" offered on a day that is not their birthday; "Haven't seen you" for a member who came yesterday

steps.action: Change the words, tap the button that opens WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on this member's chat with the words typed in
must_not: WhatsApp opening on another member's number; the amount or date in the words differing from the member page

steps.action: Turn the birthday wish on, change a number of days, tap the save button

steps.action: Type an amount above the due, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "That is more than the ₹{due} due on this membership."

user_sees: Sheet "New workout plan": ready plans to start from, or "Start empty" ("Pick every exercise yourself")
must_not: A ready plan saved before it was looked at

steps.action: Type a "Plan name", set the "Days of the plan", give a "Day name", add exercises with sets, reps and "Rest (seconds)"
user_sees: The exercise list to pick from, each with its "Main muscle"; "+ kg added (optional)" says "Empty: body weight only"
must_not: An exercise saved with no sets or with reps "NaN"

steps.action: Under "Send to" pick members, or everyone on a membership plan
user_sees: How many members will get it
must_not: Archived members, or members of another gym, in the choice

steps.action: Tap "Save plan"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the sheet closes; the plan is under "Plans" with who made it; the picked members get it in their app
must_not: Two plans from one tap; the plan saved but sent to nobody without a word

start: A member's page: "Send a plan" (one member at a time)

steps.action: Open a member and choose to send a plan
user_sees: A chooser: "Your gym’s plans" (one tap sends one), then "Or make one for them" with "Start from a ready plan" ("Beginner to advanced, filled in for you") and "Make a new plan" ("Pick every exercise yourself")
must_not: The chooser shown when workout plans are not part of the gym's plan (then one Pro note instead)

steps.action: Tap one of the gym's plans
user_sees: It is sent to this member; a bar offers Undo
must_not: The plan sent to every member; the member taken off other plans

steps.action: Tap Undo
user_sees: The member is off that plan again
must_not: The whole plan withdrawn for everyone

start: Workout plans: the card "Workout of the day" (one workout for everyone today)

steps.action: Tap "Set today’s workout"
user_sees: Sheet "Workout of the day"
must_not: Yesterday's workout offered as today's

steps.action: Pick or build the workout, tap "Save workout"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the card shows today's workout with "Change" and "Take it off"; the button now reads "+ Plan another day"
must_not: Two workouts for the same day

steps.action: Tap "Take it off"
user_sees: Sheet "Take this workout off?" with "Keep it" and "Take it off"; after yes, members no longer see it
must_not: It stays in the member app after being taken off

start: The plan builder: the trainer's own video on an exercise (another kind of content)

steps.action: On an exercise, fill "Your video of it (YouTube link, optional)" and a "Note (optional)"
user_sees: The link kept on that exercise
must_not: A link to a page that is not a video accepted with no word

steps.action: Save, then open the plan in the member app
user_sees: The member sees the trainer's video on that exercise
must_not: The video on the wrong exercise; a broken player

start: Wrong or missing values, no internet, and the Pro switch

steps.action: Tap "Save plan" with no plan name, or a day with no exercise
user_sees: A plain reason on top of the sheet; nothing saved; everything typed still there
must_not: An empty plan sent to members

steps.action: Type letters in "Reps from"
user_sees: Refused, or the box takes only numbers
must_not: "NaN" reps saved

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open Workout plans
user_sees: "Workout plans needs the internet" with "This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now."
must_not: A plan "saved" that never reaches the server

steps.action: A gym on the Starter plan, once the plan switch is on (it is off today)
user_sees: A page that says what Workout plans is and that it is part of Pro
must_not: The page working for free with the switch on; a blank page

start: A saved plan: edit, copy, withdraw

steps.action: Tap "Edit" on a plan, change a day, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Sheet "Edit workout plan"; after saving, members on the plan get the new version
must_not: The change saved over a newer change made on another device with no warning

steps.action: Tap "Make a copy"
user_sees: The builder with the same days as a new plan; the first plan unchanged
must_not: The copy sent to the same members by itself

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: Sheet "Withdraw this plan?" with "Keep it" and "Withdraw"; after yes the plan leaves "Plans" and members no longer get it
must_not: Members' own logged workouts deleted with the plan; "Could not withdraw it. Try again." with the plan half gone

steps.action: Show the withdrawn plans
user_sees: The withdrawn plan is listed there
must_not: A withdrawn plan still shown as running in the member app

start: Who gets a plan and who can see it

steps.action: Send a plan to three members
user_sees: Only those three see it in their app; the plan shows who made it
must_not: A member seeing a plan sent to someone else; a member seeing other members' names on the plan

steps.action: As front desk, open a plan made by the owner
user_sees: It can be read and changed: plans belong to the gym
must_not: Money pages opened by the same login

steps.action: Read the member app's words on trainer plans
user_sees: The trainer's plans appear on the member's Workout tab by themselves
must_not: A plan that only appears after the member signs out and in
